svg.text: One shared engine, four ways to run it — local today, sandboxed in the cloud for connected repos
THE ENGINE LOOP — EVERY TURN, EVERY MODE, ONE PIPELINE
up to N rounds, then surfaced honestly as incomplete
Degrades gracefully — any evaluator/judge model failure falls back to a heuristic. A turn always completes.
FOUR WAYS TO RUN THE LOOP — SAME ENGINE, DIFFERENT SHAPE

g.text: SINGLE TURN — the default, every prompt
patch applied to your working tree

text.tspan: Runs directly in your working directory —
no isolation needed for a single writer.

g.text: FLEET — plan a goal, dispatch subagents
N subagents — each own git worktree
merge back one at a time (rerere)

text.tspan: Two safety rules: task deps block until

g.text: BEST-OF-N — N candidates race, judge picks
each runs the SAME engine loop
winning diff applied, rest cleaned up

text.tspan: own tests, re-runs them across the whole

g.text: PR FIX — diagnose, patch, push, repeat
bounded engine turn — bare, no shell

text.tspan: Shell always resolves to 'ask' with nobody
to ask — fails closed, never runs

svg.text: Zero platform deps — every environment-specific behavior enters through five ports
Every run — local or cloud — flows through one metered, permission-gated chokepoint.
